top_signals.title: UK Energy Bills Set to Soar 26% as Iran War Drives Up Gas Prices
top_signals.summary: Energy bills for households across Britain are set to rocket from the start of next year, in a further blow to households struggling with the cost of living. Bills will surge by 26 per cent from 1 January, energy regulator Ofgem has confirmed. Ofgem said the energy price cap will rise from £1,723 to £2,166 for typical annual energy bills.
